title: NotebookLM Is Now Gemini Notebook With Its Own Cloud Computer
description:
NotebookLM isnt just an AI notebook anymore 🔥 Google gave every notebook its own cloud computer that writes and runs code to analyze your data. Its now called Gemini Notebook, 30M users already on board. New version wins 65% of tests, and web search got 78% more accurate ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
